embeds.title: BLHA TRADE CENTER
embeds.description: Where trades get started, discussed and recorded. Discord is for negotiating. Fantrax is where a trade becomes official.

fields.name: USE THESE ROOMS FOR
fields.value: Trade blocks • Acquisition targets • Trade discussion • Completed trades • Dynasty player values

fields.name: BEFORE YOU TRADE
fields.value: Read the Trades and Future Picks articles of the Constitution. Rules on timing, limits and pick trading live there, not here.

fields.name: OFFICIAL RECORD
fields.value: A trade is official only when it is processed in Fantrax. Posts here don't bind anyone.

fields.name: TRADE TALK ETIQUETTE
fields.value: Say which franchise you're offering for and what you want back, so owners can respond quickly.
